name.description: The resource name of the view. Format: projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/buckets/BUCKET_ID/views/VIEW_NAME
name.rationale: The view name is a unique identifier for the resource. It has no direct security implications beyond being a reference name.

bucket.description: The logging bucket that contains this view. Format: projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/buckets/BUCKET_ID
bucket.rationale: Bucket identifies which logging bucket the view belongs to. Has no direct security impact beyond resource identification.

description.description: A user-provided description of the log view. Maximum length of 800 characters.
description.rationale: Description is metadata only and does not affect any security controls.
description.compliant: Security view for audit logs - restricts to IAM and firewall events

filter.description: Filter that restricts which log entries in a bucket are visible in this view. Filters are restricted to be a logical AND of ==/!= of: originating project/folder/organization/billing account, resource type, log id. Example: SOURCE("projects/myproject") AND resource.type = "gce_instance" AND LOG_ID("stdout")
filter.rationale: Filter determines which logs are visible through this view. Overly broad filters may expose sensitive logs to unauthorized viewers. Restrictive filters can hide critical security events from security teams, creating blind spots.

parent.description: The parent resource of the log view. Format: projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/buckets/BUCKET_ID
parent.rationale: Parent identifies the resource hierarchy location. Has no direct security impact.

location.description: The location of the resource. Supported locations: global, us-central1, us-east1, us-west1, asia-east1, europe-west1, australia-southeast1
location.rationale: Location selection affects data residency requirements but does not directly impact security controls like encryption or access management.
